title: Memory vault: Mana only writes to Views/ and Journal/ files she created
body:
Part of #935.

Mana writes `Views/*.md` and `Journal/<day>.md` by name. If I (or a daily-notes plugin) already have a `Journal/2026-09-30.md`, she appends her diary into my note, and a `Views/Summary.md` of mine gets overwritten.

I want her to keep track of the files she created and only ever write to or remove those:
- Journal: when today's file isn't hers, use `<day> (Mana).md`; if that's taken too, skip.
- Views: a file of mine at a view's path is left alone (logged once).
- No `Mana/` subfolder nesting (already decided).
interface: A view path that holds my file is skipped with one log line, e.g. `left "views/summary.md" alone: Mana didn't create it.`. What she created is recorded in the vault's existing `memory/vault-sync.json`. `writeJournal()` returns false when it skips.
why: The largest case (about 65 lines in memory-vault.js): track which files she created and only write those. Needs reading a bigger module and keeping state.
